title: Panda reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- panda body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#dddde8'/>
  <!-- panda head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='22' fill='#e4e4ef'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='26' r='8' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='26' r='8' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='26' r='4.5' fill='#55557a'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='26' r='4.5' fill='#55557a'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='43' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='43' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <!-- eyes (looking down at book) -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='45' r='3.2' fill='#f4f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='45' r='3.2' fill='#f4f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='46' r='1.8' fill='#2a2a48'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='46' r='1.8' fill='#2a2a48'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='51' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M46 55 Q50 58 54 55' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x='24' y='62' width='52' height='28' rx='3' fill='#e85d5d'/>
  <rect x='26' y='64' width='48' height='24' rx='2' fill='#fcf4e0'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='64' x2='50' y2='88' stroke='#e85d5d' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- text lines on book -->
  <line x1='31' y1='69' x2='46' y2='69' stroke='#c9c4b0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='31' y1='73' x2='46' y2='73' stroke='#c9c4b0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='31' y1='77' x2='46' y2='77' stroke='#c9c4b0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='31' y1='81' x2='42' y2='81' stroke='#c9c4b0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='69' x2='69' y2='69' stroke='#c9c4b0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='73' x2='69' y2='73' stroke='#c9c4b0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='77' x2='69' y2='77' stroke='#c9c4b0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='81' x2='64' y2='81' stroke='#c9c4b0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- paws holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='66' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='66' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='66' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#55557a'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='66' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#55557a'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='94' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='94' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
</svg>
